channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Mamdani is against RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s Madison Square Garden event — Here’s what he said
item.description: “I don't support the rally, but I don't know if the city has any jurisdiction on cancelling a private event,” Mamdani said at a news conference when asked whether the event should be cancelled.

item.title: Iran, Oman Push Talks for ‘Interim’ Reopening of Hormuz Strait
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and his Omani counterpart Badr Albusaidi discussed an “interim framework” aimed at resuming shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, according to a joint statement carried by the Oman News Agency, as the two sides press ahead with long-running talks over navigation through the key waterway.

item.title: Harry-Meghan UK return: Why Prince William, Kate could face a new Royal family test
item.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are expected to stay at a private, nonroyal residence outside London and will not resume their royal duties, which they stepped back from in 2020.

item.title: Bengaluru elite clubs raided by health officials - Here is why
item.description: The inspections are being conducted by teams from the Food Safety Department as authorities step up scrutiny of food establishments across the city.

item.title: Why elevated section Delhi-Mumbai Expressway from Jaitpur to DND Junction in Faridabad closed again
item.description: The Delhi-Mumbai Expressway, which passes through five states, is likely to be completed by 2027–28.

item.title: CIA Director John Ratcliffe reportedly visits Moscow for undisclosed meetings amid stalled Ukraine talks
item.description: Neither the CIA nor the Russian government has publicly confirmed the visit or disclosed the purpose of the meetings.

item.title: Bangladesh could consider joining Mecca pact, in test for foreign ties: Report
item.description: Bangladesh could consider joining the Mecca pact, a mutual defence agreement signed this month between Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, a minister said

item.title: Indian IT companies unaffected by Donald Trump’s new H-1B rules as US plans to earn $8.8 billion from visa applications
item.description: Analysis suggests new H-1B visa fees may not significantly impact Indian technology companies, which have increased local hiring.

item.title: Australia bans largely AI-generated songs from official music charts
item.description: Australia has banned songs that are largely or wholly generated by AI from its official music charts, requiring eligible releases to be ‘substantially human made’.

item.title: India-China ties near normalcy? NSA Ajit Doval, Wang Yi hold key border talks ahead of BRICS summit
item.description: They also exchanged views on strengthening relations in economic, political and multilateral areas, in line with the understanding reached by the leadership of the two countries.

item.title: Canada imposes retaliatory tariffs on US goods from September 8 as Trump trade war escalates
item.description: The move follows US President Donald Trump's decision to impose new 50% tariffs on about $20 billion of Canadian imports from Saturday, after talks between the two countries failed to avert the measures.

item.title: Bournvita maker Mondelez removes claims flagged by FSSAI; Amway drops ‘100%’ label
item.description: Bournvita maker Mondelez withdraws health claims after FSSAI notice as Amway and other food companies revise labels and remove misleading claims.

item.title: No need for masks as H1N1 drives seasonal flu surge, says ICMR chief
item.description: With 99% of cases remaining mild, ICMR advises basic hygiene over masks and recommends flu shots only for high-risk individuals.

item.title: Trump wants to rename Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’: Where is it, and can the US president legally do it?
item.description: “The United States is giving serious consideration to changing the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America,” Trump said in a post on Truth Social, arguing that Washington does not expect to do much business with Ontario anymore.

item.title: Lunar Eclipse August 2026: Check visibility; date, time; will 'Blood Moon' be visible in India?
item.description: During this extraordinary event, the Earth will align between the Sun and the Moon, casting a shadow that will transform the lunar surface into a stunning red-orange display.

item.title: Comedian Zarna Garg locked in Hermès bathroom for over an hour, calls out store over 'no apology'
item.description: Indian-American comedian Zarna Garg said she was trapped in a bathroom at a Berlin Hermès store for more than an hour, with firefighters eventually called to free her.

item.title: Govt expands Hindustan Copper stake sale amid strong OFS demand
item.description: The floor price of ₹514 per share represents a more than 10% discount to the previous closing price, piling selling pressure on the stock. At the floor price, the Centre would raise about ₹2,982 crore by selling the full 6% stake, including the 3% greenshoe option to meet excess demand.

item.title: US military plane flies into Moscow amid stalled Ukraine talks; Kremlin says it has ‘no information’
item.description: The Boeing C-17 Globemaster III, carrying the US-registered tail number 07-7181, flew directly from Riga, Latvia, to Moscow and landed at around 0700 GMT.

item.title: ‘Where and how should we kill Barron Trump?’: Iranian TV video triggers US Secret Service probe
item.description: “The US Secret Service is aware of the video and investigates anything that can be perceived as a threat toward our protectees,” Secret Service spokesman Nate Herring said in a statement.

item.title: Delhi HC stops FSSAI from cancelling ITC licence over ‘100%’ claims on Aashirvaad atta
item.description: The Delhi HC stops FSSAI from cancelling ITC’s licence over ‘100%’ Aashirvaad atta claims as the court considers the regulator’s jurisdiction.

item.title: Why China matters to Trump’s Iran sanctions and how far can Beijing push back? Explained
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced new sanctions under Operation Economic Outcast targeting nearly 60 entities over Iran trade.&nbsp;

item.title: 'This is Thailand': Vendor shouts ‘Free Palestine’, asks Israeli tourists to leave his Phuket shop. Watch
item.description: A shopkeeper was seen being abused by a group of Israeli tourists in a now-viral video after they were asked to leave. Reportedly, one among the group shouted ‘Free Israel’.

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries breaks silence on Jared Kushner meeting, vows ‘Trump cartel’ accountability | Video
item.description: Hakeem Jeffries addresses his private meeting with Jared Kushner, saying Democrats will pursue the affordability crisis while holding the ‘Trump cartel’ accountable.

item.title: Piyush Goyal meets Japanese financial leaders to deepen capital flows and investment ties
item.description: Commerce minister pitches emerging sectors and policy reforms in Tokyo to help achieve a 10-trillion-yen private investment goal.

item.title: Centre to sell onions at subsidized ₹35 per kg in Delhi
item.description: The onions will be sold through government agencies, including the NCCF and Nafed, as the Centre seeks to contain rising prices.

item.title: Uber auto driver pushes stranded girl’s scooty in Bengaluru roads, Internet applauds heartwarming gesture
item.description: A video from Bengaluru has won hearts on the internet after an auto driver was seen helping a woman with a broken-down scooty. Watch video inside.

item.title: Quote of the day by Oscar Wilde on redemption: ‘Every saint has a past, and every sinner has a future’
item.description: Oscar Wilde's insights reveal that life is nuanced, with every saint's past and every sinner's future influencing their identity. He urges against strict moral categorisation, promoting the understanding that people can change and deserve compassion.

item.title: Nitin Gadkari retiring? His office clarifies on 'can't work much now' remark: ‘Nothing to do with…’
item.description: Nitin Gadkari's office issued a clarification on Tuesday, stating that his remarks had been taken out of context and were not related to politics.

item.title: Mint Explainer | Supreme Court’s ‘industry’ ruling: What it means for workers, employers
item.description: The Supreme Court's recent ruling clarifies that pending labour disputes will still rely on the 1978 definition of ‘industry’, raising pivotal questions on the interpretation of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, and its potential implications for non-profits and educational institutions.&nbsp;

item.title: US sanctions 4 Indian firms under Operation Economic Outcast: Who are they and why are they targeted?
item.description: Four Indian companies have been sanctioned by the US for importing Iranian petroleum products. These include Portease Partners LLP, Sadashiva Overseas Limited, PP Softtech, and Prakrutees Infra.&nbsp;

item.title: Mumbai auto and cab drivers move Bombay HC against Marathi language rule; say livelihoods of lakhs at risk
item.description: The petition, filed through advocate Vivek Shukla, is expected to be mentioned before the Chief Justice on August 26, with the drivers seeking urgent directions and an immediate stay on the government notification issued on August 12.

item.title: Coal India sees coal at the centre of India’s energy mix till 2047
item.description: In an interview, Coal India Chairman B. Sairam says the coal miner is expanding into renewables and eyeing exports amid rising input costs and private competition.

item.title: Girlfriend’s 3,400-kiss car stunt goes viral, Gwalior man fined ₹5,500 | Watch
item.description: A Gwalior man was fined ₹5,500 after his car, covered with 3,400 lipstick marks reportedly left by his girlfriend, was spotted on city roads. Police also ordered him to clean the vehicle and remove the marks.

item.title: Mint Explainer | FASTag local passes shift online: what changes for regular users
item.description: The National Highways Authority of India has made its digital FASTag Local Pass facility available at 121 toll plazas, allowing eligible residents to obtain monthly passes through the Rajmargyatra app. The move eases toll payments for people who regularly use a toll plaza near their homes.

item.title: Tarun Tejpal case: Supreme Court asks former Tehelka editor-in-chief to surrender within 2 weeks
item.description: The Supreme Court has ordered Tarun Tejpal to surrender within two weeks and file a surrender certificate to facilitate proper hearing of his appeal, according to Live Law.
